name: claude-code-context-fix
description: Fixes Claude Code VS Code extension's context usage ring to respect CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW / autoCompactWindow, show before first reply, and display exact token counts.

commands.title: Claude Code Context Fix: Reapply Patch

claudeCodeContextFix.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable patching the Claude Code VS Code extension's context usage indicator (`webview/index.js`).

claudeCodeContextFix.overrideWindow.markdownDescription: Optional raw context window cap in tokens (e.g. `350000`) **before** Claude Code's `33k` buffer deduction (`min(maxOutputTokens, 20000) + 13000`, so `350000` displays as `317k`). Leave `0` to auto-resolve in priority order: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW` → `modelSettings.<model>.autoCompactWindow` → `autoCompactWindow` → model's native window (further lowered if `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` is set).

claudeCodeContextFix.showTokenCounts.markdownDescription: Include exact `used / effectiveLimit` token counts (and `Model max` when capped below the model window) in the context indicator hover tooltip.

claudeCodeContextFix.showBeforeFirstRepl.markdownDescription: When `#claudeCode.contextUsageThreshold#` is `0`, show the ring immediately on a new empty session (`0 / limit`) instead of waiting for the first assistant reply.
